title: Polymarket and Kalshi continue to operate in India despite a government advisory on April 25, directed at VPN providers, labeling prediction markets "illegal" (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Polymarket and Kalshi continue to operate in India despite a government advisory on April 25, directed at VPN providers, labeling prediction markets “illegal” — Polymarket and Kalshi Inc. have been allowing customers in India to sign up and trade on their prediction markets …
